gate_rules.G10_agent_diversity_for_strata: >= 3 scaffold agents with >= 200 rollouts each, the stratum the carry-forward models report inside
gate_rules.G11_negative_constraints_present: >= 500 rollouts carrying a negative constraint, the class T140's hypothesis expects to be lost first
gate_rules.G12_source_diversity: >= 3 sources with >= 200 rollouts each, so a pooled trajectory statistic is not one collection's artefact
gate_rules.G1_trajectories_readable: >= 1,000 parsed rollouts with at least one assistant turn
gate_rules.G2_outcome_label_populated: >= 500 rollouts carry a non-null outcome label, which is what separates a successful from a failed discourse in T131 and scores an attempt in T142
gate_rules.G3_repeated_attempts_of_one_task: >= 300 tasks with two or more recorded attempts - the organisational memory the carry-forward designs read
gate_rules.G4_trajectories_long_enough_to_compress: >= 500 rollouts with six or more assistant turns, below which a compression schedule has nothing to drop
gate_rules.G5_two_plus_component_kinds: >= 1,000 rollouts whose agent prose carries at least two of the eight frozen component categories, since T137 asks which kind carries forward
gate_rules.G6_abstraction_contrast_computable: >= 1,000 rollouts containing at least one code identifier, the concrete end of the abstraction axis
gate_rules.G7_relation_classes_computable: >= 200 task groups with two or more attempts, at which a relation between two attempts (restatement, refinement, distant) can be classified at all
gate_rules.G8_observation_pairs_present: >= 1,000 rollouts contain a user turn after an assistant command, i.e. a real observation the discourse responds to
gate_rules.G9_provenance_and_uncertainty_language: >= 500 rollouts each carrying uncertainty language, which with the provenance and exception categories is what T140's H2 asks survives a compression
